cohort: 3707 women with viable, singleton, term pregnancies undergoing induction of labor between August 1995 and December 2007 at the Los Angeles County + University of Southern California Medical Center
finding: While there was no difference in cesarean delivery rates between induction methods among nulliparous women, misoprostol use was associated with a lower risk of cesarean birth in multiparous women.
mod_finding: Misoprostol use was associated with a lower risk of cesarean birth among multiparous women.
